scope: Provisional simulation physics checks, not physical measurements or certified hardware performance.

internal_torque_reactions.setup: Free system: gravity, contact, damping, stiffness and friction losses disabled; RK4 dt=0.0005 s. Ideal belt commands are zero; omitted belt rotors are not validated.

polar_shell_leverage.setup: Ideal points one metre from each hinge anchor. Confirms the geometric shell-spin singularity; the opening/belt contacts are checked separately.

contact_phase_sweep.setup: KINEMATIC FIXTURE: base pose held, 0.5 mm floor penetration, no dynamic balance claim. Map columns are shaft/shell A/shell B rad/s and belt A/belt B m/s. Concatenated contact maps are a geometric diagnostic, not a controllability proof.

belt_input_wrapper.setup: Free dynamic plant, settled for 0.05 s at each pole. Zero/nonzero commands are compared from identical integration states through Plant.step; no externally applied force.

zero_input_response.setup: Free base, gravity on, all three joint efforts and both prescribed belt speeds zero. Zero belt speed is an ideal holding servo, not a freely spinning unpowered belt.
